_comment: Grandfathered axe-core violations (warren-b629), impact serious or critical only. Each entry is keyed by manifest page id + axe rule id (optionally narrowed to a viewport or theme) and names the seed that fixes it. The list only shrinks: an entry that stops reproducing fails bun run check:ui-visual, so delete it in the PR that fixes it. New entries need a tracker id and review justification; a11y-checks.test.ts holds the entry count to a ceiling that only goes down.

allowlist.reason: the console shell's scrolling <main> holds no focusable element on the phone Instance page, so keyboard users cannot scroll it
